summary: Motorsport Games Inc. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026, disclosing a share repurchase agreement with Driven Lifestyle Group LLC to buy back 904,395 shares of Class A common stock at $4.11 per share, the five-day VWAP. Upon repurchase, all Class B shares held by Driven Lifestyle are automatically cancelled, reducing dual-class overhang. The seller executed an irrevocable consent to approve charter and bylaw amendments that broaden the board's power to alter governance provisions. The transaction is immediate, with no stated premium or regulatory clock. What to watch: governance changes and potential further capital returns as the controlling block unwinds.
